formulas.formula: Plan for the little one, from the nursery to the first birthday.
Setup: the due date (or birthday), what's in your baby fund and what you can save each month.
Gear: everything you need, with when you need it. Mark Bought, Gift, Hand-me-down or Skip.
Monthly Costs: diapers, formula, daycare... with the baby month they start and stop.
Plan: the whole first year month by month, planned vs what you really spent.
Spending: log what you buy. Gifts: who gave what, and tick the thank-you.
They cost $0 here. The Dashboard shows how much they saved you.
Month 1 starts on the birthday. Before baby covers everything earlier.
Often the biggest cost. Set it to start the month you go back to work.
Not every gadget is needed. Mark Skip and watch your total drop.
Welcome to the world, little one.
